description: This file defines a 'BulkSelect' class for handling bulk selection and actions in the Superset ListView interface, including methods for toggling bulk select mode, selecting/deselecting rows, and performing bulk actions.

classes.name: BulkSelect
classes.description: A component for managing bulk selection and actions within the Superset ListView, providing methods to enable bulk mode, select/deselect rows, and trigger bulk actions.

methods.name: getToggleButton
methods.description: Returns the button element that toggles bulk select mode.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables bulk selection mode by clicking the toggle button.

methods.name: getRowCheckbox
methods.description: Retrieves the checkbox element for a specific row identified by name.

methods.name: selectRow
methods.description: Checks the checkbox for a specified row to select it.

methods.name: deselectRow
methods.description: Unchecks the checkbox for a specified row to deselect it.

methods.name: getControls
methods.description: Returns the locator for the bulk select controls container.

methods.name: getActionButton
methods.description: Retrieves a bulk action button by its name.

methods.name: clickAction
methods.description: Clicks a specified bulk action button.
